Capcom makes Resident Evil, resources and horror a playable consequence rather than a statement and lets the audience understand its meaning through action.

replacements.old_heading: Sony Tries to Put PlayStation in a Pocket Without Making It a Miniature
replacements.old_body: Sony Computer Entertainment announced PSP on May 13, 2003, presenting a new handheld platform intended to extend PlayStation beyond the living room. replacements.old_heading: An Announcement Before the Machine
replacements.old_body: In May 2003 Sony did not yet show a retail-ready PSP, but publicly defined the project: a handheld platform inside the PlayStation family, scheduled for the following year. The move signaled an ambition to enter a sector where Nintendo had built decades of experience. Sony brought a different promise, offering graphics, audio and multimedia content close to the imagination of home consoles. Before the hardware itself, PSP therefore began as a statement about what playing away from home could mean. The choice works because it is repeated and tested. In PlayStation Portable (PSP), E3 announcement and handheld strategy gains value over time, turning a local solution into a stable part of how the game is remembered.
replacements.heading: The original PSP-1000 hardware
replacements.body: The launch model of the PlayStation Portable, referred to as the PSP-1000, features an oblong form factor measuring 6.7 by 2.9 by 0.9 inches (170 by 74 by 23 mm). The front of the system features the speakers as well as most of the system's controls, including the face buttons, d-pad, and analog stick, with other function buttons below the screen. It also contains the system's 4.3-inch (110 mm) TFT display, which is capable of 480 × 272 pixel display resolution and 24-bit color. The top of the system contains the two shoulder buttons, labelled L and R, the Wireless LAN and UMD eject switches, an IrDA infrared emitter, and a Mini USB port for data transfer. Below the system is the AC-in and 2-pin dock ports for charging, as well as the 3.5 mm audio and remote ports. The left and right sides of the system have the Memory Stick PRO Duo slot and power switch, respectively. The back gives access to the UMD drive and battery slot when either are uncovered. As a whole, the unit weighs 9.9 ounces (280 g).
